notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS product analytics team evaluating Redwood hosted API for quick POC -> move to Dedicated (VPC) if perf/costs align. Primary workstreams: embeddings-based search, nightly batch upserts, semantic reranking in product UI.

Background: Seafarer EmbedWorks builds product analytics UI (session summarization, contextual search across docs + metrics). Have ~350 employees, run multi-tenant SaaS with strict data residency for EU customers. Looking to add semantic search + similarity-based recommendations. Currently prototype with open-source embeddings and a hosted vector DB.

Technical requirements / targets (from product & infra leads):
- Query latency (top-k retrieval) target: <=80ms 95p for simple queries (warm).
- Throughput target: 150-400 qps for search endpoints during peak; batch embedding pipeline: nightly 50k vector upserts.
- Consistency: synchronous upsert visibility for some flows (indexing window <=10m).
- Metadata store: Postgres for joins; must integrate vector DB that supports metadata filters.
- Model preferences: flexible — prefer open embeddings (small/medium) on hosted, but want ability to pin quantized LLMs on Dedicated for cost.

POC & demo notes (timeline):
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (Jordan R) — scoped use-cases, asked for hosted API quickstart.
- 2026-01-20: Hosted API POC kickoff — ingest 20k rows, prototype search UI (using text-embedding-3-small).
- 2026-02-01: Perf sync (Fireflies ff-20260201-8231) — initial hosted API avg top-k latency ~110ms, 95p spikes at 240ms under concurrency. Team flagged batching & prefix caching needs.
- 2026-02-10: Vector DB connector trial — tested Pinecone + Milvus; Pinecone easier but cost uncertain. (email thread-Gm-20260210-8272).
- 2026-02-15: Deep technical review w/ infra + SE (Fireflies ff-20260215-9142). Discussed Dedicated capacity estimates and VPC peering.

POC findings so far (observations from SE):
- Hosted API is fastest to iterate; embeddings quality acceptable.
- Throughput ceiling on hosted plan without dedicated pools: spikes cause 95p latency > SLA.
- Nightly batch upsert throughput: hosted ingestion OK for 50k but takes longer than target window; Dedicated expected to reduce ingest time via parallel upserts.
- Vector DB choices: Pinecone integration path is shortest; Milvus ok but ops heavier. Want recommendation from Redwood Optimize about batch tuning + quantization strategies for embedding model.

Security & compliance:
- Need SOC2 attestation and SSO (SAML) before procurement.
- Must support EU data residency for subset of datasets.
- Request for audit log examples and retention policy (drive://redwood/security/Seafarer_SSO_SOW.docx).

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, ARR expectation ~75k-250k.
- Preference for predictable committed capacity model (Dedicated reserved pool) if unit economics hit target.
- Ask: sample committed pricing for 4 GPU-pool equivalent, estimated token cost vs hosted.

Customer quotes / soundbites from calls: "Hosted POC great for iteration — but if we can't get 95p latency under 100ms at scale we won't move to production." — Product Lead.
"We need predictable nightly indexing windows; current prototype occasionally runs >2 hours which breaks our SLA." — Data Eng.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood SE (Leah Wong) to deliver POC perf report w/ actionable config changes (batching, parallel upserts) by 2026-03-05.
- Pricing worksheet & committed capacity proposal from AE (Jordan) by 2026-03-12.
- Schedule executive demo + infra review for 2026-03-18 (aim to approve Dedicated pilot).

Blockers (customer view):
- Need validated Dedicated throughput numbers for target workload (real dataset).
- Alignment on vector DB choice + migration path from prototype.
- Finalizing internal budget / legal for VPC & data residency.

Attachments / links: pricing deck (drive://redwood/proposals/seafarer_poc_pricing_v1.pdf), security SOW draft, Fireflies call ids, Jira tickets opened for infra sizing (INF-2381, INF-2456).

Notes tone: fragmented bullets, some direct quotes, CRM shorthand. Follow-up tasks tracked in AE/SE calendar.
notes_summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API POC -> Dedicated (VPC) for embeddings + semantic search. Key asks: throughput verification, vector DB integration guidance, committed pricing. SE to deliver perf report; AE to provide pricing.
